body:
TUNGSTEN SESSION REPORT — 2026-09-04 (ledger sessions 134-137, WARRANT#442-454)

=== THE HEADLINE ===
This build had NEVER opened a trade in the project's history. Tonight I found out why: FIVE
control-flow bugs, four now fixed. Every one was the same mistake — the system read "I have no
information yet" as "I got a bad result."

Then, with the machine unjammed, a new adaptive system reached BELT L4 of 6 on walk-forward
proving: on bars it had never seen, in 4 of 5 periods, the trades it chose were PROFITABLE
BEFORE COST. It can find winning moments. It cannot yet pay the spread. Gap: 0.0615 R/trade.

=== THE FIVE BLOCKERS ===
446  Calibration could never restart. Every abort path cleared isCalibrating and returned false
     WITHOUT setting isComplete, and the only code that sets isCalibrating=true lives in a
     one-shot initPhase==8 branch. Proof it was a bug: that block contains calibrationAttempts++
     and a 5-attempt cap — a retry counter in a block that runs once can only ever reach 1.
     FIXED.
447  The drift detector fired on the ABSENCE of trades. With zero trades liveWR=0 and livePF
     falls to 1.0, so _wrDrift and _pfDrift were both true, giving reason code 4 "multiple drift
     factors" — a CATASTROPHIC recalibration that tore down the calibration that had just
     succeeded. Fifteen lines above, the sibling checks _calWeak and _liveWeak are already
     sample-guarded. These two were missed. FIXED with CATREC_MIN_LIVE_N=20.
448  The ghost gate spent its evidence budget waiting for evidence. It demanded 15 trades in
     5-MINUTE windows (one M5 bar), reset its counters each round, and raised its own entry
     threshold by 3 points because the win rate read 0.0 — which meant "no data". Six rounds,
     then MAXED OUT. An existing guard diagnosed this correctly in its own comment and then
     burned an extension on every wait. FIXED.
449  EVERY SCORE WAS COMPRESSED 11%. The normaliser's six coefficients were supposed to be each
     component's maximum contribution; measured against the export, none was right and they were
     wrong in BOTH directions — momentum 115% of its cap, volume 139%, pattern 23%. _refMax read
     169 where components reach 152.25. Consequence: the entry threshold floor (60) sat ABOVE the
     score's own 99th percentile (55.69), so under 1% of bars could ever fire. FIXED; p99 now
     +61.8 and the floor is clearable for the first time.
450  C5.5 sizing, per Manuel's decision: size is now either >= minRisk or NO TRADE. Deleted the
     block that INFLATED risk to 2.5% exactly when the reducers wanted it small, and stopped
     MathMax(minLot,...) turning a computed zero into one minimum lot — so C5.1's Kelly-at-low-n
     and C5.2's drawdown fade can finally stop the system trading. FIXED.
     (Still open: hasHistoricalInsights timing — the historical sweep runs on ~900 bars because
     MT4 gives the tester ~1,001 at init, so the ghost gate never sees its 864-signal sample.)

=== THE MEASUREMENT REFRAME ===
Manuel: "we are reporting how good it becomes at that as edge not edge as an overall sum of all
our losses plus wins". Every number this campaign had produced was mean R over ALL BARS, which is
near zero by construction. Replaced with ceiling / floor / capture:
  ceiling (best 10% with foresight) +1.45 R  |  floor (take everything) -0.47 R  |  gap 1.92 R
Capture went 2.3% -> 19.5% tonight.

=== THE ADAPTIVE SYSTEM (WARRANT#453) ===
EV(b|x) = p(win|x,b)*(TP/SL) - (1-p) - spread/(SL*ATR_x); take argmax_b, sit out if negative.
121 features (112 from a causality-self-tested battery, max deviation 0, planted canary caught).
  best FIXED bracket       -0.17784 R
  adaptive, never sits out -0.21365
  adaptive + sit-out       -0.12645
  + selectivity (EV 0.20)  -0.06152   at 24.8 trades/day, 50.5% WR
  random bracket same rate -0.30769
  ORACLE (hindsight)       +0.41772
  shuffled control         collapses to 17 trades / 99.8% sit-out
Choosing the bracket is worth +0.18 R over random at the same rate; sitting out +0.087;
selectivity a further +0.065. It uses all 8 brackets, so the adaptivity is real.
The selectivity curve has a genuine optimum at ~25 trades/day and DEGRADES past it.

=== THE PROVING GROUND (WARRANT#454) — BELT L4 of 6 ===
  L1 CHOOSES  beats random bracket at same rate    5/5  EARNED
  L2 ADAPTS   beats best fixed bracket             3/5  EARNED
  L3 SITS OUT beats its own never-sit-out variant  5/5  EARNED
  L4 PROFITS  positive BEFORE cost                 4/5  EARNED
  L5 BREAKEVEN positive after cost                 0/5
  L6 AT SPEED  L5 at 12-25 trades/day              0/5
NOT improving with data: slope -0.063 per e-fold, correlation -0.877. A rolling 6,000-entry
window beat the expanding window in only 2 of 5 folds, so recency is NOT the lever — the later
periods are genuinely harder. More history will not fix this.

=== WHAT THIS MEANS ===
Every remaining lever is a COST lever, not a signal lever: volatility selection (the same stop
costs 4.2x less in the busiest volatility quintile), wider stops, broker spread, limit-order
entry. We are no longer looking for an edge; we are trying to keep one already measured.

=== ERRORS I MADE AND CORRECTED ===
* Converted all 66,018 line endings to CRLF on a 27-line edit (68KB spurious diff). Caught via
  byte delta, restored, redone surgically. Edit scripts must use newline="" on read AND write.
* Placed new #defines below their use site; MQL4's preprocessor is textual top-to-bottom. Caught
  before compiling.
* Ranked regimes by MAXIMUM excess across regimes whose n differed 67x — a max-statistic inflated
  by 1/sqrt(n). The "regimes differ by 4.8 SE" verdict was noise; corrected to compare z.
* MANUEL CAUGHT: my bracket grid topped out at a 1.6 payoff ratio, so "high ratios are worse" came
  from a grid that barely contained any — the same boundary error as WARRANT#437. Worse, I ranked
  by MEAN R when his compounding argument is about the GEOMETRIC mean. Agent now re-testing to 6:1
  under log-growth and Kelly with drawdown and streak distributions.

=== BOARD ===
29 of 46 automated MET. C1.5 and C2.2 earned this session. C7 held for last per instruction.
C6.3 / C6.5 / C6.6 / C4 all still blocked on one real trade.

=== IN FLIGHT ===
* ratio/compounding under log-growth + Kelly (Manuel's hypothesis, tested properly)
* closing the 0.0615 R gap: continuous labels, probability calibration, overlap-aware weighting,
  cross-instrument holdout
* TradingView lens scan, two agents: volume/order-flow/liquidity/structure, and
  volatility/cycles/statistics/adaptive-filters. Looking for what predicts a LARGE move, since
  that is what the cost problem needs.

Build: TUNGSTEN_10.66_APEX_QUANT_SLS(181).mq4, 0 errors 0 warnings, deployed byte-identical.
